name: Fennel
siboNotes: Fennel is well-tolerated in SIBO and may have mild digestive benefits due to its traditional use for digestive comfort.
preparationTips: Remove tough outer layers and slice thinly for raw preparations
Roast or braise to bring out natural sweetness
Save feathery fronds as a low-FODMAP herb garnish
Cut away the hard core if using raw in salads
